premises.text: After-school private tutoring is essential for success in MENA, but many students struggle to find a qualified, accessible, available tutor quickly
premises.evidence_span: One out of three students struggle to find a tutor. And it takes, on average, four to five hours to find someone who's qualified, accessible, and available

premises.text: A peer-to-peer app connects students to pre-vetted tutors via course pick, preference-based selection, and direct booking
premises.evidence_span: a peer-to-peer platform that connects students to highly qualified private tutors in three simple steps

premises.text: Built-in online tutoring with note sharing, whiteboarding, video, chat, ratings, and progress reports
premises.evidence_span: we build our online tutoring system from scratch with note sharing, whiteboarding, and video functionalities

premises.text: ML-assisted tutor hiring plus graph-based matching recommend tutors by proximity, education, and hours tutored
premises.evidence_span: we have an algorithm that favors our tutors based on several criteria, like proximity, education background, number of hours tutored

premises.text: Peer tutors with similar educational backgrounds are rewarded with pay, internships, training, and bonuses
premises.evidence_span: we match students with peer tutors who have been in their shoes and have the same educational background

premises.text: Arabic MENA-focused GTM with 20% tutor commission and planned institutional analytics subscriptions
premises.evidence_span: We charge our tutors a 20% commission per transaction

value.text: Make education accessible by matching students quickly to qualified peer tutors online or in person

causal_links.evidence_span: connects students to highly qualified private tutors in three simple steps

notes: §4.1.6: closed centers, commute, and long search time folded into one tutor-finding pain (P1). Demo booking/chat/location steps folded into marketplace (P2). Online session features kept as one capability package (P3). Student/tutor traction and Ministry MOUs excluded. Market-size doubling vision excluded (§4.1.4).
